g.text: SYSTEM HIERARCHY OVERVIEW (CO2037 PROJECT 1 - YOLO UNO REDESIGN)

g.desc: SYSTEM HIERARCHY OVERVIEW (CO2037 PROJECT 1 - YOLO UNO REDESIGN)

g.text: - Sheet 2 (01_Power_Supply): 6-12V DC Reverse-Polarity MOSFET (AO3407A) + SMBJ15CA -> 5.05V/2A Sync Buck (TPS54202) + TPS2116 Power-Mux -> +5V & AP2114H-3.3 (1A) -> +3V3

g.desc: - Sheet 2 (01_Power_Supply): 6-12V DC Reverse-Polarity MOSFET (AO3407A) + SMBJ15CA -> 5.05V/2A Sync Buck (TPS54202) + TPS2116 Power-Mux -> +5V & AP2114H-3.3 (1A) -> +3V3

g.text: - Sheet 3 (02_MCU_ESP32S3): ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 (16MB Flash, 8MB Octal PSRAM, 3.3V VDD_SPI), Decoupling (22uF+100nF), EN RC Delay (10k/1uF) & BOOT (GPIO0)

g.desc: - Sheet 3 (02_MCU_ESP32S3): ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 (16MB Flash, 8MB Octal PSRAM, 3.3V VDD_SPI), Decoupling (22uF+100nF), EN RC Delay (10k/1uF) & BOOT (GPIO0)

g.text: - Sheet 4 (03_USB_and_LEDs): USB Type-C 16P (5.1k Rd x2) + USBLC6-2SC6 ESD, User LED D13 (GPIO48, 270 Ohm), WS2812B NeoPixel + SN74LV1T34 Level Shifter (GPIO45 + 10k PD)

g.desc: - Sheet 4 (03_USB_and_LEDs): USB Type-C 16P (5.1k Rd x2) + USBLC6-2SC6 ESD, User LED D13 (GPIO48, 270 Ohm), WS2812B NeoPixel + SN74LV1T34 Level Shifter (GPIO45 + 10k PD)

g.text: - Sheet 5 (04_Peripherals_and_Headers): Arduino UNO R3 Headers, 12x Grove (4 Analog, 4 Digital, 4 I2C), QWIIC, 1.5k I2C Pull-Ups, A0 0-5V Divider (JP1), 4x Servo GVS + 470uF

g.desc: - Sheet 5 (04_Peripherals_and_Headers): Arduino UNO R3 Headers, 12x Grove (4 Analog, 4 Digital, 4 I2C), QWIIC, 1.5k I2C Pull-Ups, A0 0-5V Divider (JP1), 4x Servo GVS + 470uF
